svg.title: Inside /tk:execute
svg.desc: Execute starts from your approved plan and records where the run starts. For every step it writes the step's check first, runs it before the work, where it must fail for the reason the plan stated, does the work, and runs it again, where it must pass. A failing step gets up to 3 fix attempts; still failing, the run stops and asks you. A step that builds a UI runs a design loop of up to 5 rounds for a new surface, 2 for an improved one. Each green step is committed, and after the last one the run hands off to review.
